== Description ==

[[Greg Shaw]] (right) being congratulated at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025; remaining faces unlabeled, including a young man with glasses in the left foreground, a man in a maroon hoodie and Seattle cap, and the person hugging him.
